reason: Standalone server registers 27 implemented read-only GA4 Data/Admin and local validation tools through core and surface modules.

tools.name: ga4_health_check

propertyId.description: Optional property ID to check metadata and property details for

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description:
Run a GA4 analytics report with intelligent query planning. Supports 52 metrics, 63 dimensions, auto-pagination.
Use ga4://metrics and ga4://dimensions resources for available fields. Max 9 dimensions + 10 metrics per request.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (7daysAgo, yesterday)

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday)

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

orderBy.description: Metric or dimension key to sort by

orderDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected ordering field.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

offset.description: Optional 0-based row offset for explicit pagination.

autoPaginate.description: When true, omit the limit so the GA4 client paginates through all rows using offset.

sources.role: registration wrapper and top-level parameter description augmentation

tools.behavior: Plans selected catalog/API fields and calculated metrics, validates local compatibility, then runs Core report and flattens rows; enriches calculated metrics locally. Explicit limit gives one page; autoPaginate removes limit and client reads 250000-row offset pages until reported rowCount or an empty page.
notes: Explicit startDate/endDate only used together; otherwise planner resolves datePreset/default. Auto-pagination debug requestCount remains 1 even when several report requests occur.

dimensions.description: Realtime dimension API names, e.g. eventName, city, deviceCategory

minuteRanges.description: Optional named realtime minute ranges; zero is the current minute.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

keepEmptyRows.description: Keep provider rows whose selected metrics are all zero, where supported.

sources.role: registration wrapper and top-level parameter description augmentation

tools.behavior: Maps catalog field names and forwards raw filters, orderings, minute ranges and selected fields to realtime reporting, requesting quota state; returns flattened data and limited-field warning.

tools.name: ga4_run_funnel_recipe
tools.description: Run a read-only configurable funnel recipe using one GA4 report per eventName/pagePath step and return simple step counts.

name.description: Optional display name for this funnel step

eventName.description: GA4 eventName to count for this step

pagePath.description: GA4 pagePath to count for this step

matchType.description: String match type for pagePath. eventName always uses EXACT.

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps. Each step needs eventName or pagePath.

metric.description: Metric used for the analysis; use a name from the platform metric catalogue.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (7daysAgo, yesterday)

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday)

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

sources.role: registration wrapper and top-level parameter description augmentation

tools.behavior: Runs one Core aggregate report per step, combining eventName EXACT and pagePath string filters with AND. Computes independent counts, ratios and dropoffs locally.
notes: Steps are counted independently; results do not track user sequences or deduplicate across steps. Zod refinement requires a truthy eventName or pagePath per step.

sources.role: registration wrapper and top-level parameter description augmentation

tools.behavior: Lists existing export snapshots and summarizes states; optionally gets one export and queries a small sample. Samples only when resource name and includeRowSample are provided; identifier columns redact unless opted in. Creates no export.

tools.description: Run the GA4 Data API v1alpha runFunnelReport endpoint with optional breakdown/next-action, falling back to read-only step counts if unavailable.

name.description: Optional display name for this funnel step

eventName.description: GA4 event name matched by a FunnelEventFilter

fieldValue.description: String value to match for fieldName

matchType.description: String match type for pagePath or fieldName

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps using eventName, pagePath, or fieldName+fieldValue

breakdownDimension.description: Optional breakdown dimension, e.g. deviceCategory or sessionDefaultChannelGroup

breakdownLimit.description: Maximum breakdown values to include in the funnel response.

nextActionDimension.description: Optional next action dimension, commonly eventName

nextActionLimit.description: Maximum next actions returned for each funnel step.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (7daysAgo, yesterday)

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday)

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

sources.role: registration wrapper and top-level parameter description augmentation

tools.behavior: Builds native v1alpha funnel event/field expressions and sequence/timing constraints, optional breakdown and next-action fields, then runs funnel report. On any endpoint failure, default fallback runs independent activeUsers Core counts for steps; disabling fallback rethrows.
notes: Zod refinement requires eventName, pagePath, or both fieldName and fieldValue per step. Fallback ignores sequence, timing, breakdown and next-action semantics.

tools.name: ga4_run_pivot_report
tools.description: Run a read-only GA4 Data API pivot report with native filters, ordering, quota state, multiple date ranges, and up to 250,000 pivot cells. Every pivot requires an explicit limit.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property ID or properties/{id}.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD or a GA4 relative date such as 28daysAgo.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD or a GA4 relative date such as today.

cohortSpec.description: Native GA4 CohortSpec JSON. Omit dateRanges for cohort requests.

report.description: Native GA4 report request object for this endpoint.

sources.role: registration wrapper and top-level parameter description augmentation

tools.behavior: Maps names to native GA dimension/metric objects, validates pivot field declarations/uniqueness and cell budget, strips property from request body, runs native pivot report and returns raw and flattened rows.
notes: Report refinement requires nonempty dateRanges or cohortSpec. Native filters, orderings, cohortSpec and comparisons are arbitrary JSON records; their internal GA API shapes are intentionally not validated.
Handler requires pivot fields to be declared dimensions (except dateRange/comparisons), forbids repeated fields across pivots, and limits product of pivot limits to 250000.

notes: Source review only; no upstream execution, tools/list or live requests. All 27 tools register unconditionally, with no permission tiers or optional module switch.
CLI startup requires nonempty OAuth client ID, client secret and refresh token; package requires Node >=22.12.0.
Descriptions preserve literal registered strings, including catalog-count claims; these are not treated as implementation inventory counts.

Input schemas reconstructed from Zod; objects strip unknown keys and represented with additionalProperties=false. Arbitrary z.record(z.unknown()) fields retain open JSON. Custom refine predicates are noted per tool and not represented as invented standard JSON Schema constraints.
installToolQuality adds top-level shared parameter descriptions, read-only annotations and structured result envelope without changing handler calls.

review.method: Independently reconstructed all 27 Zod registrations with allowlisted schema constructors and compared descriptions and complete schemas, including shared pivot/report/funnel shapes and parameter-description augmentation. The audience resource regex differs only by equivalent slash escaping. Reviewed native client endpoints, ecommerce diagnostics, health checks and native-versus-independent funnel fallback.
